name: Beat FX Tab
author: biser
summary: The collapsed BEAT FX tab shows the selected effect and its beat value.
description: Turns the small BEAT FX tab on the right of the 2 DECK waveform screen into a display: the selected effect and its beat value (or LENGTH % for REVERB), grey while the effect is off and in the effect's X-PAD colour while it sounds. It hides while the Beat FX panel is open. It only reads the mixer's Beat FX report and touch positions; it never changes an effect, a frame or a touch.
